comments: The colophon suggests that it is an eulogy to 'Jad gzhon nu byang chub (ID:3863) by a disciple, but it could be possible that the colophon is mistaken and that it is an eulogy, by 'Jad pa (the author of the work that precedes on the same manuscript, (ID:4516)) to his own bla ma, an hypothesis that could find some support in the two-line annotation in smaller script that follows, which distinguishes a "bla ma" from Shag kya'i dge slong gzhon nu byang chub.
alternative_names:
bla ma la bstod pa (incipit)
g+hu ru sta ba
shAkya'i dge slong gzhon nu byang chub la bstod pa (colophon)
name: bla ma la bstod pa
